meta.en: Role: Mtawala (leader) remembered as an archer, healer and diviner
meta.sw: Jukumu: Mtawala anayekumbukwa kama mpiga mishale, mganga na mtabiri
meta.dg: Kazi: Mtawala anayetambukirwa dza mpiga uha, mgbwanga na mtabiri

blocks.en: Among the Wadigo of the Tanga coast, one early leader is remembered by name: Bandilo. A short Swahili account of Wadigo history, retold on Tanzanian websites and social media, describes him as a ruler (*mtawala*) whose standing came from his skill with the bow, his knowledge of medicine and his gift for foretelling events. Everything we can say about him comes from that one account, so this article keeps close to its words.
blocks.sw: Miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya Tanga, kiongozi mmoja wa zamani anakumbukwa kwa jina: Bandilo. Simulizi fupi ya Kiswahili kuhusu historia ya Wadigo, inayosambazwa kwenye tovuti na mitandao ya kijamii ya Tanzania, inamweleza kama mtawala aliyepata hadhi yake kutokana na ustadi wake wa upinde, ujuzi wake wa dawa na kipaji chake cha kutabiri mambo. Kila tunachoweza kusema kumhusu kinatoka katika simulizi hiyo moja, kwa hivyo makala hii inafuata maneno yake kwa karibu.
blocks.dg: Kahi za Adigo a pwani ya Tanga, chilongozi mmwenga wa kare anatambukirwa kpwa dzinare: Bandilo. Adisi fupi ya Chiswahili ya historia ya Adigo, inayosemurirwa tsona kpwenye tovuti na mitandao ya chijamii ya Tanzania, inamueleza dza mtawala ariyephaha hishimaye kpwa ufundiwe wa uha, ujuziwe wa tiba na uwezowe wa kutabiri mambo. Chila chitu hunachoweza kugomba kumhusu chinakula kpwa adisi hiyo mwenga, phahi makala hino taiuka kure na manenoge.

blocks.en: The account says Bandilo was greatly respected because he was skilled in the use of arrows. He also had expertise in traditional medicine, and could predict all kinds of events.
blocks.sw: Simulizi hiyo inasema Bandilo aliheshimiwa sana kwa sababu alikuwa *hodari katika matumizi ya mishale*. Pia alikuwa na *utaalamu wa dawa za asili*, na aliweza *kutabiri matukio mbalimbali*. (jaribio)
blocks.dg: Adisi inagomba kukala Bandilo kala anaishimiwa sana kpwa sababu kala ni fundi wa kuhumira mivi. Piya kala ana ujuzi wa tiba ya chienyeji, na kala anaweza kutabiri mambo ga chila aina.

blocks.en: Archery fits what outside observers saw in the Digo country of Tanga. The German geographer Oscar Baumann travelled through it in 1890. He noted that even in villages a few hours from the coast, men carried bows and reed arrows with barbed iron heads, and that guns were rare. A leader praised for archery was praised for the skill on which his people's defence depended.
blocks.sw: Ustadi wa upinde unaendana na yale ambayo wageni waliona katika nchi ya Wadigo wa Tanga. Mwanajiografia wa Kijerumani Oscar Baumann alisafiri katika eneo hilo mwaka 1890. Aliandika kwamba hata katika vijiji vilivyo umbali wa saa chache kutoka pwani, wanaume walibeba pinde na mishale ya matete yenye vichwa vya chuma vyenye ndoano, na kwamba bunduki zilikuwa nadra. Kiongozi aliyesifiwa kwa upinde alisifiwa kwa ustadi ambao ulinzi wa watu wake ulitegemea.
blocks.dg: Ufundi wa uha unalingana na mambo garigoonwa ni ajeni kahi za tsi ya Adigo a Tanga. Oscar Baumann, mwanajiografia Mjerumani, wasafiri kahi za tsi hiyo mwaka 1890. Waona kukala hata kpwenye vidzidzi virivyokala saa chache tu kula pwani, chila mlume kala anatsukula uha na mivi ya mridza yenye ntsa za chuma za ndoano, na kukala bunduchi kala ni adimu. Chilongozi ariyetogolwa kpwa uha kala anatogolwa kpwa ufundi ambao atue kala anauluphira kpwa kudzirinda.

blocks.en: Healing and divination belonged to the same world. Among the Digo, as among other Mijikenda, the *mganga* treated illness and read the causes of misfortune, which were often thought to be spiritual as well as physical. The account links Bandilo's authority to this role. It also says the Wadigo believed in the spirits of their ancestors, called *Madibwe* or *Adibwe*, who after death gained the power to protect or to trouble the living.
blocks.sw: Uganga na utabiri vilikuwa sehemu ya ulimwengu huo huo. Kwa Wadigo, kama ilivyo kwa Wamijikenda wengine, *mganga* alitibu magonjwa na kuchunguza vyanzo vya mikosi, ambavyo mara nyingi viliaminika kuwa vya kiroho na vya kimwili pia. Simulizi hiyo inaunganisha mamlaka ya Bandilo na kazi hii. Inasema pia kwamba Wadigo waliamini mizimu ya mababu zao, walioitwa *Madibwe* au *Adibwe*, ambao baada ya kufa walipata uwezo wa kuwalinda walio hai au kuwasumbua.
blocks.dg: Kuphoza akongo na kutabiri kala ni mambo ganagohusiana. Kpwa Adigo, dza kpwa Amijikenda anjina, *mgbwanga* kala anaphoza akongo na kulola sababu za mashaka, ambazo mara nyinji kala zinaaminiwa kukala ni za chiroho na za chimwiri piya. Adisi inaunganisha mamlaka ga Bandilo na kazi hino. Piya inagomba kukala Adigo kala anaamini roho za akare ao, ambao anaihwa *Madibwe* au *Adibwe*. Bada ya kufwa, akare aho kala anaphaha uwezo wa kurinda ario moyo, au kuayuga.

blocks.en: According to the account, Bandilo's reputation reached beyond his own people. The source says that his work of divination and healing earned him the respect of the rulers of other peoples too, who came to him for divination and to seek solutions to all kinds of problems that needed hard decisions.
blocks.sw: Kwa mujibu wa simulizi hiyo, sifa za Bandilo zilivuka mipaka ya watu wake: *"Kazi ya utabiri na utabibu ilisababisha mtawala huyo kuheshimiwa pia na watawala wa makabila mengine ambao walifika kwake kufanya utabiri na kutafuta suluhu za matatizo mbalimbali yanayohitaji maamuzi magumu."*
blocks.dg: Kulengana na adisi, Bandilo kala anaishimiwa hata ni atu ambao si atue. Adisi inagomba kukala kaziye ya kutabiri na kuphoza yamphaha hishima hata ya atawala a makabila ganjina, ambao kala anakpwedza kpwakpwe kutabiriwa na kuhendza njira za kumala mashaka ganagolonda maamuzi magumu.

blocks.en: The account does not say which peoples these were. The Wadigo of Tanga lived among the Bondei, Segeju and Shambaa, and Baumann records feuds and wars with all three. In those wars the Digo usually beat the Bondei but usually lost to the Segeju and to the Shambaa under Hungura. Bondei tradition remembers a war with the Digo, the Milonge war, which a Tanzanian historian dates to the late 17th or early 18th century. A diviner whom neighbouring rulers trusted would have mattered in a region with this much conflict, but the sources do not tell us which rulers came to Bandilo, or when.
blocks.sw: Simulizi haitaji makabila hayo ni yapi. Wadigo wa Tanga waliishi pamoja na Wabondei, Wasegeju na Washambaa, na Baumann anaandika juu ya uhasama na vita na makabila yote matatu. Katika vita hivyo Wadigo kwa kawaida waliwashinda Wabondei, lakini kwa kawaida walishindwa na Wasegeju na Washambaa chini ya Hungura. Mapokeo ya Wabondei yanakumbuka vita na Wadigo, vita vya Milonge, ambavyo mwanahistoria mmoja wa Tanzania anavikadiria kuwa vya mwishoni mwa karne ya 17 au mwanzoni mwa karne ya 18. Mtabiri aliyeaminiwa na watawala jirani angekuwa na umuhimu mkubwa katika eneo lenye migogoro mingi kiasi hiki, lakini vyanzo havitwambii ni watawala gani waliomjia Bandilo, wala lini.
blocks.dg: Adisi taigomba ni makabila gani. Adigo a Tanga kala anaishi phamwenga na Abondei, Asegeju na Ashambaa, na Baumann anaandika kondo na viha na makabila gosi mahahu. Kahi za viha hivyo, mara nyinji Adigo kala anashinda Abondei, ela mara nyinji kala anashindwa ni Asegeju na ni Ashambaa ariolongozwa ni Hungura. Mapokeo ga Abondei ganatambukira viha na Adigo, viha vya Milonge, ambavyo mwanahistoria mmwenga wa Tanzania anavikadiria kukala vya mwisho wa karne ya 17 au mwandzo wa karne ya 18. Mtabiri ariyekuluphirwa ni atawala a jirani angekala muhimu sana kahi za seemu yenye kondo nyinji dza hino, ela vyanzo tavihuambira ni atawala ani ariokpwedza kpwa Bandilo, wala ni rini.

blocks.en: The same account describes a ritual for peace. To strengthen peace in the community, it says, their ruler "known as Bandiwe" set aside a special day for a *tambiko*, an offering and prayer asking for peace and blessings. On that day he wore formal dress and led a prayer, followed by a great celebration. People gathered carrying hoes and spears, then ate, drank and danced to the drums.
blocks.sw: Simulizi hiyo hiyo inaeleza tambiko la kuomba amani. Inasema kwamba ili kuimarisha amani katika jamii, mtawala wao "aliyejulikana kama Bandiwe" alitenga *siku maalumu* kwa ajili ya *tambiko*, yaani sadaka na dua ya kuomba amani na baraka. Siku hiyo alivaa mavazi rasmi na kuongoza dua, kisha ikafuata sherehe kubwa. Watu walikusanyika wakiwa wamebeba majembe na mikuki, kisha wakala, wakanywa na kucheza kwa ngoma.
blocks.dg: Adisi hiyo hiyo inaeleza mila ya kuvoya amani. Inagomba kukala, ili kutiya nguvu amani kahi za jamii, mtawala wao "ariyemanyikana dza Bandiwe" watenga siku maalumu kpwa *tambiko*, yani sadaka na mavoyo ga kuvoya amani na baraka. Siku hiyo wavwala nguwo za hishima na achilongoza mavoyo, chisha kuchikala na sherehe kulu. Atu ahutana achitsukula majembe na mafumo, chisha achirya, achinwa na kufwiha kpwa ngoma.

blocks.en: The spelling here is *Bandiwe*, not *Bandilo*. This is most likely the same leader under a variant or misspelt name, but the account does not say so. The account does not explain the hoes and spears. They were the everyday tools of farming and of defence, carried to a ceremony that asked for peace and blessing.
blocks.sw: Hapa jina limeandikwa *Bandiwe*, si *Bandilo*. Huenda ni kiongozi yule yule kwa jina mbadala au lililokosewa kuandikwa, lakini simulizi haisemi hivyo. Simulizi pia haielezi maana ya majembe na mikuki. Hivyo vilikuwa vifaa vya kila siku vya kilimo na vya ulinzi, vilivyobebwa kwenye sherehe ya kuomba amani na baraka.
blocks.dg: Hipha dzina rinaandikpwa *Bandiwe*, si *Bandilo*. Inaonekana ni chilongozi yuyo yuyo kpwa dzina ranjina, au kpwa dzina ririroandikpwa kpwa kukosa, ela adisi taigomba hivyo. Adisi piya taieleza mana ya majembe na mafumo. Gago kala ni vifaa vya chila siku vya chirimo na vya kudzirinda, virivyotsukulwa kpwenye sherehe ya kuvoya amani na baraka.
Kpwa Utu Wani Kumbukumbu ni Chache

blocks.en: Bandilo's story survives in a single short Swahili text. It appears almost word for word on a Tanzanian blog (2017), on a Tanga community page and in a JamiiForums thread on Wadigo history. No author is named, and no elder is quoted. The text cites Martin Kayamba's "Notes on the Wadigo", published in *Tanganyika Notes and Records* in 1947, which may be where the story of Bandilo was first written down. That article has not yet been checked. Vincent Nkondokaya's book on the origins of the Tanga Wadigo (2006) is also said to mention Bandilo, but no copy has yet been read for this project. The same online text also makes claims that historians reject, such as placing Shungwaya in West Africa. So it is a weak guide to detail, even if the memory of Bandilo is genuine.
blocks.sw: Hadithi ya Bandilo imebaki katika maandishi mafupi mamoja tu ya Kiswahili. Yanapatikana karibu neno kwa neno kwenye blogu ya Kitanzania (2017), kwenye ukurasa wa jamii ya Tanga na kwenye mjadala wa JamiiForums kuhusu historia ya Wadigo. Hakuna mwandishi anayetajwa, wala mzee yeyote anayenukuliwa. Maandishi hayo yanataja makala ya Martin Kayamba "Notes on the Wadigo", iliyochapishwa katika *Tanganyika Notes and Records* mwaka 1947, ambayo huenda ndiyo mahali hadithi ya Bandilo ilipoandikwa kwa mara ya kwanza. Makala hiyo bado haijachunguzwa. Kitabu cha Vincent Nkondokaya kuhusu asili ya Wadigo wa Tanga (2006) nacho kinasemekana kumtaja Bandilo, lakini bado hakuna nakala iliyosomwa kwa ajili ya mradi huu. Maandishi hayo hayo ya mtandaoni pia yana madai ambayo wanahistoria wanayakataa, kama vile kuiweka Shungwaya Afrika Magharibi. Kwa hiyo ni mwongozo dhaifu kwa mambo ya kina, hata kama kumbukumbu ya Bandilo ni ya kweli.
blocks.dg: Adisi ya Bandilo inaphahikana kahi za maandiko mafupi ga Chiswahili tu, na takuna ganjina. Ganaphahikana karibu neno kpwa neno kpwenye blogu ya Chitanzania (2017), kpwenye ukurasa wa jamii ya Tanga na kpwenye mjadala wa JamiiForums kuhusu historia ya Adigo. Takuna mwandishi anayetajwa, wala takuna mzehe ambaye manenoge ganatajwa. Maandiko gago ganataja makala ya Martin Kayamba "Notes on the Wadigo", iriyochapishwa kpwenye *Tanganyika Notes and Records* mwaka 1947, ambayo inawezekana ndiyo phatu ambapho adisi ya Bandilo yaandikpwa kpwa mara ya kpwandza. Makala hiyo taidzangbwelolwa. Chitabu cha Vincent Nkondokaya cha asili ya Adigo a Tanga (2006) piya nkugombwa kukala chinamtaja Bandilo, ela kpwa mradi uhu tahudzangbwesoma nakala yoyosi. Maandiko gago gago ga mtandaoni piya gana madai ambago anahistoria anagakahala, dza kuika Shungwaya Afrika Magharibi. Phahi taganaweza kuluphirwa kpwa mambo madide-madide, hata chikala kumbukumbu ya Bandilo ni ya kpweli.

blocks.en: Baumann, the main German writer on the Tanga Digo, does not mention Bandilo. He describes a people whose villages were "not under chiefs but governed by a few elders". Now and then one elder rose to special standing, such as the blind headman of the village of Zirihini or the feared leader Jambia. A true chief over all the Wadigo, Jumbe Mamfulla of Gombelo, was first installed by the German authorities. On the Kenyan side, each Digo kaya was governed by a council of elders, the *ngambi*, led by a senior elder (*mwanatsi*) from the founding matrilineal clan. In a society governed this way, a single remembered "ruler" stands out. It also means power was shared, and individual leaders were rarely written into the record.
blocks.sw: Baumann, mwandishi mkuu wa Kijerumani kuhusu Wadigo wa Tanga, hamtaji Bandilo. Anawaeleza kama watu ambao vijiji vyao "havikuwa chini ya machifu bali vilitawaliwa na wazee wachache". Mara kwa mara mzee mmoja alipanda hadhi ya pekee, kama mkuu kipofu wa kijiji cha Zirihini au kiongozi aliyeogopwa, Jambia. Chifu halisi wa Wadigo wote, Jumbe Mamfulla wa Gombelo, aliwekwa kwa mara ya kwanza na utawala wa Kijerumani. Upande wa Kenya, kila kaya ya Wadigo ilitawaliwa na baraza la wazee, *ngambi*, likiongozwa na mzee mkuu (*mwanatsi*) kutoka ukoo wa kuzaliwa upande wa mama ulioanzisha kaya hiyo. Katika jamii inayotawaliwa kwa namna hii, "mtawala" mmoja anayekumbukwa anajitokeza. Pia inamaanisha kuwa mamlaka yaligawanywa, na viongozi mmoja mmoja mara chache waliandikwa katika kumbukumbu.
blocks.dg: Baumann, mwandishi mkpwulu Mjerumani ariyeandika kuhusu Adigo a Tanga, kamtaja Bandilo. Anaaeleza dza atu ambao vidzidzi vyao "tavikala na machifu, ela kala vinatawalwa ni azehe achache". Mara kpwa mara mzehe mmwenga kala anaphaha hishima kulu kuriko anjina, dza mkpwulu chipofu wa chidzidzi cha Zirihini, au chilongozi ariyekala anaogophwa, Jambia. Chifu wa kpweli wa Adigo osi, Dzumbe Mamfulla wa Gombelo, waikpwa kpwa mara ya kpwandza ni utawala wa Chijerumani. Uphande wa Kenya, chila kaya ya Adigo kala inatawalwa ni baraza ra azehe, *ngambi*, rinarolongozwa ni mzehe mkpwulu (*mwanatsi*) wa fuko ririroandzisha kaya hiyo. Kahi za jamii inayotawalwa hivi, "mtawala" mmwenga anayetambukirwa anaonekana wazi. Piya ina mana kukala mamlaka kala ganaganywa, na ni mara chache vilongozi mmwenga-mmwenga kuandikpwa kahi za kumbukumbu.

blocks.en: No source dates Bandilo, names his village or his clan (*fuko*), or records his deeds beyond those described above.
blocks.sw: Hakuna chanzo kinachotaja wakati wa Bandilo, kijiji chake au ukoo wake (*fuko*), wala matendo yake zaidi ya yale yaliyoelezwa hapo juu.
blocks.dg: Takuna chanzo chinachogomba Bandilo waishi rini, wala chinachotaja chidzidziche au fukore (*fuko*), wala chinachoandika mahendoge zaidi ya garigoelezwa dzulu.

blocks.en: Bandilo is remembered for three things: the bow, medicine and foresight. He is also remembered for a day set aside to pray for peace. The memory of him as someone whom neighbouring rulers came to for counsel offers a picture of leadership that is still valued among the Wadigo: authority earned through knowledge and trust. Finding out more about him is one of the open tasks of Digo history. Kayamba's notes, Nkondokaya's book and the recollections of Tanga elders may yet tell us when he lived, where he led and how his name has been handed down.
blocks.sw: Bandilo anakumbukwa kwa mambo matatu: upinde, dawa na kuona mbele. Anakumbukwa pia kwa siku aliyoitenga kuomba amani. Kumbukumbu yake kama mtu ambaye watawala jirani walimwendea kupata ushauri inaonyesha sura ya uongozi ambayo bado inathaminiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo: mamlaka yanayopatikana kupitia maarifa na kuaminika. Kujua zaidi kumhusu ni mojawapo ya kazi zilizo wazi katika historia ya Wadigo. Maandishi ya Kayamba, kitabu cha Nkondokaya na kumbukumbu za wazee wa Tanga huenda bado vikatueleza aliishi lini, aliongoza wapi na jinsi jina lake lilivyorithishwa.
blocks.dg: Bandilo anatambukirwa kpwa mambo mahahu: uha, tiba na kuona mbere. Piya anatambukirwa kpwa siku ariyoitenga kuvoya amani. Kumbukumbuye dza mutu ambaye atawala a jirani kala anakpwedza kpwakpwe kuhendza shauri inaonyesa sura ya uongozi ambayo hata sambi inathaminiwa kahi za Adigo: mamlaka ganagophahikana kpwa ujuzi na kuaminika. Kumanya zaidi kumhusu ni kazi mwenga ya historia ya Adigo ambayo taidzangbwehendwa. Maandiko ga Kayamba, chitabu cha Nkondokaya na kumbukumbu za azehe a Tanga vinaweza kuhuambira Bandilo waishi rini, walongoza kuphi, na dzinare ritsapizwa viphi kula chizazi hadi chizazi.

sources: Wor'Out Media, "Wajuwa asili ya Wadigo waliopo Tanga", 1 January 2017. The same text appears on the Tanga Tanzania community page and in the JamiiForums thread "Historia ya Kabila la Wadigo" (thread 787278).
